request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Bramblejaw Boar".

Creative brief
Name: Bramblejaw Boar
Collection: Briarwild Brood. Woodland animals reshaped by an ancient living forest, using thorns, seeds, roots, sap, and leaf-pattern projectiles.
Core concept: A lane-controlling charger that releases sideward bramble bursts.
Body and silhouette: Low muscular boar with a heavy head, thick shoulders, short legs, and forward-curving tusks.
Signature features: Interwoven bramble mane, bark-plated forehead, and leaf-wrapped tusks.
Palette and materials: Dark umber, thorny green, weathered tan, and dull ivory.
Movement personality: Stubborn, aggressive, and momentum-driven.
Attack concept: Scrapes the ground to telegraph a straight charge, then fires perpendicular thorn sprays from both sides while rushing forward.
Directional details: The left tusk is broken near its tip.
Avoid: Domestic pig, flaming boar, overly detailed individual vines.
